name: detect_rfq_flow
description: Analyze user message to detect which RFQ creation flow they prefer: turn-by-turn (one item at a time), bulk text (multiple items), excel upload, or unclear

flow_type.description: The detected RFQ creation flow preference

confidence.description: Confidence score as percentage (0-100) for the flow detection

turn_by_turn.description: Confidence score for turn-by-turn flow (single item description, one at a time, up to 3 items)

bulk_text.description: Confidence score for bulk text flow (multiple items in one message, up to 10)

excel_upload.description: Confidence score for excel upload flow

flow_scores.description: Confidence scores for all RFQ flow types

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of why this flow was detected and key indicators in the message

detected_indicators.description: Specific words or phrases that indicated the flow choice

suggested_response.description: If unclear, suggest what clarification or next step message to send to user

contains_item_details.description: Whether the message contains actual item details (quantities, descriptions, etc.) vs just flow preference

estimated_item_count.description: If contains item details, estimated number of items mentioned in the message
